summary: iter_28 (voice mics + i18n + responsive) — ALL tests PASS. Backend voice/transcribe endpoint correctly enforces auth (401) and rejects too-short payloads (400). Both voice mic buttons (voice-dictate-btn yellow + voice-send-btn red-dot) render on /chat and /create with fully localized FR/ES tooltips matching spec. Discover step 4 (d_b4 Chat screen) contains 🎙️ emoji + two-mics copy in FR/EN/RU/ZH. Responsive verified at 360px mobile + 1280px desktop on /, /discover, /dashboard: 0px horizontal overflow. Landing navbar at 360px shows all 3 columns (lang-toggle + logo + discover). Dashboard header at 360px shows sidebar-toggle + lang-toggle + tutorial-btn. Landing fully translated in RU/ZH/PT (no English fallback).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py line 3208 — voice/transcribe endpoint is clean: auth-gated via get_current_user, size-gated (<25MB / >200B), content-type permissive (logs unknown types but still forwards to Whisper which auto-detects). Returns proper 401/400/413/422/500. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY lookup is lazy-imported inside the try block — good for cold start perf.

/app/frontend/src/components/VoiceRecorder.jsx — MediaRecorder API with graceful permission-denied toast, localized via t('mic_voice_permission'). testid is composed as `voice-${mode}-btn` which matches the spec (voice-dictate-btn / voice-send-btn).

/app/frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.js — all 12 languages have mic_voice_send / mic_voice_text / mic_voice_permission / mic_voice_badge / mic_voice_unsupported keys; d_b4 tutorial body contains 🎙️ + two-mics phrasing in FR/EN/ES/DE/NL/RU/ZH/ZH-TW/HI/BN/PT/UR (spot-checked 4 of 12 live in browser — all green).

Landing/Discover/Dashboard responsive breakpoints (px-3 sm:px-6, gap-2 sm:gap-3, hidden md:inline labels, sm:hidden mobile variants of LanguageToggle) work correctly: no horizontal overflow at 360px on any of the 3 pages. overflow-x-hidden on Landing root prevents decorative gradient leaks.

Chat.js / Create.js — both wire VoiceRecorder mode='dictate' (onResult fills input) + mode='send' (onResult calls sendText/generateApp directly with transcribed text). generateApp now accepts overrideText param — good pattern to avoid setState race.
Nothing to fix — implementation is solid and matches the spec end-to-end.
